# IMAP — Toutes disciplines (automatisé)

## Paramètres globaux

```{r parametres}
N_ITER_PAR_TD <- 300  # 300 x 3 valeurs de td = 900 itérations par couple

# Valeurs de td testées : max(Age) + offset
TD_OFFSETS <- c(5, 10, 15)

# Bornes — A et betar négatifs
lower_imap <- c(A = -100000, alpha0 = 0.001, alphar = 0.001, betar = -5)
upper_imap <- c(A = -0.001,  alpha0 = 5,     alphar = 5,     betar = -0.001)
```

## Fonctions utilitaires

```{r fonctions}
generate_starts_imap <- function() {
  list(
    A      = runif(1, -1000, -0.1),
    alpha0 = runif(1, 0.01, 1),
    alphar = runif(1, 0.001, 0.5),
    betar  = runif(1, -2, -0.01)
  )
}

# Formule IMAP avec td fixé
imap_pred <- function(Age, A, alpha0, alphar, betar, td) {
  A * exp((alpha0 / alphar) * (1 - exp(-alphar * Age))) *
    (1 - exp(betar * (Age - td)))
}

# t_pic numérique
calc_t_pic_imap <- function(params, td, age_range = c(10, td - 0.1)) {
  tryCatch(
    optimize(function(t) -imap_pred(t,
                                    A      = params["A"],
                                    alpha0 = params["alpha0"],
                                    alphar = params["alphar"],
                                    betar  = params["betar"],
                                    td     = td),
             interval = age_range)$minimum,
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )
}
```

## Préparation des données brutes (top 39)

Les données sont issues de `table_finale` (top 39 par discipline et sexe),
filtrées sur Age 16-40 avec la performance brute positive.

```{r preparation}
disciplines_courses <- c(
  "100 Metres", "200 Metres", "400 Metres",
  "800 Metres", "1500 Metres", "5000 Metres",
  "10,000 Metres", "3000 Metres Steeplechase",
  "Marathon", "110 Metres Hurdles", "100 Metres Hurdles",
  "400 Metres Hurdles", "20 Kilometres Race Walk"
)

disciplines_terrain <- c(
  "Discus Throw", "Hammer Throw", "Javelin Throw", "Shot Put",
  "Long Jump", "Triple Jump", "High Jump", "Pole Vault",
  "Decathlon", "Heptathlon"
)

toutes_disciplines <- unique(c(disciplines_courses, disciplines_terrain))

# Fonction : récupérer les données brutes pour un couple (sex, discipline)
get_data_brute <- function(sex_val, disc_val) {
  
  # Performance positive : courses = -mark_numeric, terrain = mark_numeric
  df <- table_finale %>%
    filter(Sex == sex_val, discipline == disc_val,
           Age >= 16, Age <= 40) %>%
    mutate(perf = ifelse(mark_numeric < 0, -mark_numeric, mark_numeric)) %>%
    filter(perf > 0, !is.na(perf), is.finite(perf))
  
  if (nrow(df) < 10) return(NULL)
  df %>% select(Age, perf)
}
```

## Estimation IMAP — Boucle principale

```{r estimation_imap, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
sexes <- c("men", "women")
resultats_imap <- data.frame()

for (sex in sexes) {
  for (disc in toutes_disciplines) {

    # Disciplines mono-sexe
    if (sex == "men"   && disc == "Heptathlon")          next
    if (sex == "men"   && disc == "100 Metres Hurdles")  next
    if (sex == "women" && disc == "Decathlon")           next
    if (sex == "women" && disc == "110 Metres Hurdles")  next

    df_disc <- get_data_brute(sex, disc)
    if (is.null(df_disc)) next

    max_age  <- max(df_disc$Age)
    best_fit_global <- NULL
    min_rmse_global <- Inf
    best_td         <- NA

    # Boucle sur les 3 valeurs de td
    for (offset in TD_OFFSETS) {
      td_val <- max_age + offset

      formule <- as.formula(paste0(
        "perf ~ A * exp((alpha0/alphar) * (1 - exp(-alphar * Age))) * (1 - exp(betar * (Age - ", td_val, ")))"
      ))

      best_fit_td <- NULL
      min_rmse_td <- Inf

      for (i in 1:N_ITER_PAR_TD) {
        result <- tryCatch({
          nlsLM(
            formule,
            data    = df_disc,
            start   = generate_starts_imap(),
            lower   = lower_imap,
            upper   = upper_imap,
            control = nls.lm.control(maxiter = 1000, maxfev = 2000)
          )
        }, error = function(e) NULL)

        if (!is.null(result)) {
          rmse <- summary(result)$sigma
          if (rmse < min_rmse_td) {
            min_rmse_td <- rmse
            best_fit_td <- result
          }
        }
      }

      # On garde le meilleur td
      if (!is.null(best_fit_td) && min_rmse_td < min_rmse_global) {
        min_rmse_global <- min_rmse_td
        best_fit_global <- best_fit_td
        best_td         <- td_val
      }
    }

    # Stockage des résultats
    if (!is.null(best_fit_global)) {
      params <- coef(best_fit_global)
      t_pic  <- calc_t_pic_imap(params, td = best_td)

      resultats_imap <- bind_rows(resultats_imap, data.frame(
        Sex        = sex,
        discipline = disc,
        A          = params["A"],
        alpha0     = params["alpha0"],
        alphar     = params["alphar"],
        betar      = params["betar"],
        td         = best_td,
        t_pic      = t_pic,
        RMSE       = min_rmse_global,
        AIC        = AIC(best_fit_global),
        BIC        = BIC(best_fit_global),
        converge   = TRUE
      ))

      assign(paste0("best_fit_imap_", sex, "_", gsub("[ ,]", "_", disc)),
             best_fit_global, envir = .GlobalEnv)
      assign(paste0("td_imap_", sex, "_", gsub("[ ,]", "_", disc)),
             best_td, envir = .GlobalEnv)

    } else {
      resultats_imap <- bind_rows(resultats_imap, data.frame(
        Sex = sex, discipline = disc,
        A = NA, alpha0 = NA, alphar = NA, betar = NA,
        td = NA, t_pic = NA, RMSE = NA, AIC = NA, BIC = NA,
        converge = FALSE
      ))
    }

    cat("Traité :", sex, "-", disc,
        "| Converge :", !is.null(best_fit_global),
        if (!is.null(best_fit_global)) paste0(
          "| RMSE : ", round(min_rmse_global, 3),
          " | td : ", best_td,
          " | t_pic : ", round(t_pic, 1)
        ) else "",
        "\n")
  }
}
```

## Résultats

```{r resultats}
print(resultats_imap %>%
  select(Sex, discipline, t_pic, td, RMSE, AIC, BIC, converge) %>%
  arrange(Sex, discipline))

non_convergees <- resultats_imap %>% filter(!converge)
if (nrow(non_convergees) > 0) {
  cat("\nDisciplines sans convergence :\n")
  print(non_convergees %>% select(Sex, discipline))
} else {
  cat("\nToutes les disciplines ont convergé.\n")
}
```

## Visualisations par famille

```{r helper_graph}
plot_famille_imap <- function(disciplines_h, disciplines_f, titre, ylabel,
                              ncol_graph = 3, filename) {
  rows <- list()
  for (sex in c("men", "women")) {
    discs <- if (sex == "men") disciplines_h else disciplines_f
    for (disc in discs) {
      fit_name <- paste0("best_fit_imap_", sex, "_", gsub("[ ,]", "_", disc))
      if (!exists(fit_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)) next

      df_disc <- get_data_brute(sex, disc)
      if (is.null(df_disc)) next

      fit <- get(fit_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)
      df_disc$pred   <- predict(fit)
      df_disc$Epreuve <- disc
      df_disc$Sexe    <- sex
      rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- df_disc
    }
  }
  if (length(rows) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))
  df_total <- bind_rows(rows)

  p <- ggplot(df_total, aes(x = Age, y = perf)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.4, color = "darkblue", size = 1) +
    geom_line(aes(y = pred), color = "red", size = 1) +
    facet_wrap(~ Sexe + Epreuve, ncol = ncol_graph, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(title = titre, x = "Âge", y = ylabel) +
    theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90"),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

  print(p)
  ggsave(filename, plot = p, width = 12, height = 9)
}
```
